thread:
morgan: FYI Clearsky (CS-210) flagged duplicate ingestion charges on INV-2026-05-28. They were billed twice for a reprocessed batch on 5/20; total duplicate amount is $412.50. Can finance review for a credit memo?

marta: Thanks @morgan. Do you have the invoice line and the calculation for the duplicate amount?

morgan: INV-2026-05-28 lines: 
- realtime_ingest_tokens: 825,000 tokens @ $0.0005 = $412.50 (duplicate batch reprocessed erroneously)
Customer expects full credit of $412.50 or a refund applied to their account.

nina: I checked ingestion logs. There was a reprocess job that retried a completed batch after a consumer lag spike; dedupe failed for that window. Snippet: ```2026-05-20T04:22:11Z WARN reprocessor: batch reprocessed id=bch-77 dedupe_miss=true reason=consumer_lag```

billing-bot: Created FIN-5033 to track Clearsky duplicate-ingest credit request; linked to INV-2026-05-28.

marta: Policy: system-caused duplicate billing -> full credit. For partner retention we can offer a small goodwill if needed, but policy is to apply credit memo first. Approve amount?

pavel: I can approve up to $1k for operational billing errors. Approve the full $412.50 credit. Ledger note please.

marta: Ledger justification: "Duplicate ingestion charged due to reprocessor dedupe miss on 5/20; issued full retro credit $412.50. Approved by finance lead pavel." GL: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

pavel: Approved. Create a credit memo and apply to invoice (credit balance).

marta: Creating credit memo CM-2026-102 for $412.50, attaching FIN-5033 and applying to INV-2026-05-28. Posting ledger entry under SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

billing-bot: CM-2026-102 created and applied to INV-2026-05-28. No refund issued; credit applied to account.

nina: I'll add a fix to the reprocessor to enforce idempotent handling and add a reconciliation query to surface any other dedupe misses. Linking PR + runbook to FIN-5033.

morgan: Customer notified and confirmed credit applied; they asked for a short note on remediation for their procurement team.

marta: Attached remediation summary to FIN-5033 and updated invoice notes. Marking ticket resolved pending PR merge.

pavel: Good work. Mark FIN-5033 resolved after PR merge.

morgan: Thanks all :thumbsup:
